question: What was the distance covered in the march?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage states that Mahatma Gandhi and his followers walked **240 kilometers** from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi.
 
• This distance is explicitly mentioned in the text as part of the description of the Dandi March.
 
• Other options (**100 km, 500 km, 50 km**) do not match the information provided in the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dandi March covered a total of 240 km, making it one of the most famous non-violent protests in India’s freedom struggle.
 
• This march was a direct action against the British salt tax and inspired many to join the freedom movement.
